_comment: Curated label→ARASAAC-id picks that beat exact-keyword matching. Keys MUST be lowercase — build-seed-symbols.mjs looks up label.toLowerCase(), so a capitalised key silently does nothing. Examples fixed here: 'stop' keyword-matched a bus stop; 'five' matched a CLOCK FACE showing 5 o'clock (arasaac:39311, category 'day hours') because its keywords include 'five' and '5' — every other number uses the [number] series 2627-2630, so five continues it at 2631. That one reached all four boards, since the localised maps derive from this one.
